description: Compare full local observations with separately trained no-pheromone PPO policies before generating attack or detector data.
selection_rule: No automatic winner selection. Retain every completed and failed run. A candidate can advance only if full-input PPO exceeds its same-seed separately trained no-pheromone PPO and random baseline on declared development diagnostics across all three training seeds. Final maps, final attack settings, detector fitting, and held-out evaluation are out of scope.
required_reports: per-training-seed stochastic and deterministic delivered-food means
full-minus-no-pheromone paired difference on the declared diagnostic maps
random-action baseline on the same diagnostic maps
training/runtime provenance and all failed runs
